title: Self-Pay Visit Package Cancellation and Refund Policy
content:
**Confirmation of the cancellation.** Where the tier requires the patient's signed cancellation request, a refund needs the patient's own confirmation of the cancellation; the request is registered first and the package is cancelled once the patient confirms. An active package cancelled this way is closed as refunded and its unused visits are removed.

**Full refund.** A Self-Pay Visit Package with no visits used is refunded in full only when the cancellation is requested no later than the tier's full-refund window in calendar days after the purchase date. Days are counted as calendar days from the purchase date, the purchase date itself being day zero; the comparison is "not later than", and the last day of the window itself qualifies. The purchase date is the one on that package's own record.

**After the full-refund window.** The clause that, otherwise, where the tier allows a prorated refund, the refund is the amount paid less the visits used valued by the tier's valuation of used visits and less the tier's administrative fee, never below $0.00 — together with its calculation of the used-visit value and of that prorated refund — is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis for the refund on a cancellation. Where the tier does not allow a prorated refund, nothing is refunded after the full-refund window.

**Other clauses in force**

- Reinstatement fees are never refunded.
- The refund is issued within the tier's processing period in calendar days after approval, back to the original card when issued within the tier's card-refund period of that card payment, and otherwise by check.
- An unpaid purchase may be withdrawn at any time, with nothing to refund; the withdrawn purchase is closed as cancelled.

**Boundary cases on the full-refund window (hypothetical, a 14-day window, no visits used)**

| Cancellation requested on | Day count from the purchase date | Full refund |
|---|---|---|
| The purchase date | day 0 | Yes |
| The 14th calendar day after purchase | day 14 | Yes — the boundary day qualifies |
| The 15th calendar day after purchase | day 15 | No |

A package with one or more visits used is not refunded in full, whatever the day of the request.

superseded_clauses: Otherwise, where prorated_refund_allowed is true, the refund is the amount paid less the visits used valued by refund_used_visit_valuation and less refund_admin_fee, and never below 0.00;
